findings.title: Security (surface 5): injection
findings.body:
Reachability: Source: Feishu IM message content parsed at service/feishu_finance_agent.go:319 (`_ = common.UnmarshalJsonStr(msg.Content, &content)`); text extracted at :320 (`text := strings.TrimSpace(feishuMentionPlaceholder.ReplaceAllString(content.Text, ""))`), stored as action.RawText at :334, then passed to the LLM parser at :359 (`cmd, err := parseFeishuFinanceAgentCommand(ctx, text)`). Chain: parseFeishuFinanceAgentCommandLLM (service/feishu_finance_agent_client.go:279) receives the raw text with no neutralization and embeds it as the user-role chat message at :286 (`{"role": "user", "content": text}`). Sink: the payload is serialized and sent to the interpreting engine at :349 (`req, err := http.NewRequestWithContext(ctx, http.MethodPost, cfg.LLMBaseURL+"/chat/completions", bytes.NewReader(raw))`) via :355 `feishuFinanceAgentHTTP().Do(req)`.
Note: Prompt injection into the LLM command parser: any whitelisted-operator message (including pasted third-party content in groups, as the PR's own threat-model comment at service/feishu_finance_agent.go:31 acknowledges) is concatenated into the chat-completions prompt and can attempt to override the system prompt to steer intent, target_account, commission rate or gift_credits toward arbitrary users/amounts. Mitigations present but do not remove the path: strict json_schema (with field-level fallback validation for json_object), deterministic server-side bounds in buildFeishuFinanceAgentPlan (gift capped at feishuFinanceAgentMaxGiftCredits=1,000,000, rate at 5000 bps, window 1-365 days), regex injection-hint warnings rendered on the confirmation card, and execution only after a Root-operator card confirmation with re-auth; the parsed plan is persisted server-side (plan_json) and buttons carry only action_id.
findings.recommendation: Fix the issue, or provide evidence that the path is not reachable.

findings.title: Security (surface 7): SSRF
findings.body:
Reachability: env var FEISHU_FINANCE_AGENT_OPENAPI_BASE read at setting/feishu_finance_agent_setting.go:32 (os.Getenv) -> FeishuFinanceAgentSetting.OpenAPIBase -> loaded via setting.GetFeishuFinanceAgentSetting() at service/feishu_finance_agent_ws.go:35 -> runFeishuFinanceAgentWSSession cfg.OpenAPIBase -> feishuFinanceAgentWSDomain() at service/feishu_finance_agent_ws.go:111-118 (strips trailing "/open-apis") -> larkws.WithDomain(domain) at service/feishu_finance_agent_ws.go:102 -> larkws.NewClient(cfg.AppID, cfg.AppSecret, opts...).Start() at service/feishu_finance_agent_ws.go:105-106 dials the outbound WebSocket to the env-chosen host
Note: The outbound long-connection endpoint can be redirected to an arbitrary host via the FEISHU_FINANCE_AGENT_OPENAPI_BASE deployment variable; a rogue endpoint then receives the AppID/AppSecret during the SDK auth handshake and terminates all Feishu events and card callbacks. The source is operator-controlled deployment config (setting/feishu_finance_agent_setting.go:15 documents it as a local smoke-testing affordance), not end-user request input, so exploitation requires control of the process environment; row recorded because the source->sink->chain path is fully concrete in the supplied diff.
findings.recommendation: Fix the issue, or provide evidence that the path is not reachable.
